item.title: NEAR Token Holds Near $5.25 Amid Key Resistance Test
item.description:
NEAR Token Holds Near $5.25 Amid Key Resistance Test

NEAR is trading near $5.25 after a strong run.

📈 Current Price Action

  • Since August, the coin has climbed from under $2 to above $5, and the primary trend still points up.
  • Price has hit the same area several times without closing above it, which makes investors nervous.
  • The daily chart still favors buyers.
  • Price remains well above its main moving averages, and the sharp drop to about $4.30 was fully bought back.
  • Volume has been lighter in recent days, so the market is waiting for a clean move.

🔑 Key Resistance and Support Levels

  • The region between $5.30 and $5.60 is the key test.
  • Price reached about $5.56 in late September and about $5.65 in early October; both times sellers pushed it back down.
  • Each rejection made the area look stronger, leading many to call it unbreakable.
  • If NEAR closes a full day above $5.65 with strong volume, the ceiling is broken.
  • A close above $5.65 turns the chart strongly bullish.
  • Next targets are around $6.00, then the round $6.50 level.
  • A bounce from the $5.00 area would support this view.
  • Volume should also expand on the breakout day and hold up on any retest, indicating buyers are willing to defend the new level.
  • If price fails again between $5.30 and $5.60, a pullback is likely.
  • First support sits near $4.90, then near $4.45, where the recent sell‑off stopped.
  • If $4.45 breaks, the bullish setup weakens and price could test $4.00.
  • A close below $4.90 would be an early warning that the pullback is deepening.

📊 Technical Outlook

  • Watch the daily close.
  • Until NEAR holds above the top of the $5.30‑$5.60 range, the safer view is that it remains stuck between these levels.

⚠️ Risk Considerations

  • A close below $4.90 is an early warning sign of deeper downside.
  • Light volume in recent days suggests the market may wait for a decisive move before committing.

Source: Can Near Protocol (NEAR) Finally Break $5.3? This Is Why It Looks Unbreakable - U.Today

item.title: AI Agent Layer expands tokenized AI agents and updates market metrics
item.description:
AI Agent Layer expands tokenized AI agents and updates market metrics

AI Agent Layer has released an update that broadens its ecosystem of autonomous AI agents and provides new details on token economics and market activity.

🔍 Overview

  • AI Agent Layer facilitates a dynamic ecosystem of autonomous AI agents.
  • Users can create AI agents from personalized Twitter personas or custom descriptions.
  • Each AI Agent is tokenized by default and linked to the platform’s native token, $AIFUN.

🧩 How it works

  • Agents are built using data from source X and user‑provided information.
  • Tokens representing each AI Agent become tradable on decentralized exchanges once the bonding curve reaches 100 %.
  • Every AI Agent creation and purchase adds liquidity to the $AIFUN pool.
